fields.description: Full SCIM path of the attribute carrying identifiers, for example urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:enterprise:2.0:User:employeeNumber. On SAML login the leaf name (employeeNumber) is read from the assertion.
fields.label: SCIM Path

fields.description: Separator when the identity provider sends several identifiers in one string.
fields.label: Delimiter

fields.description: Table fieldname on User, for example social_logins or barcodes.
fields.label: User Table Field

fields.description: Field in the child table that holds the identifier, for example userid or barcode.
fields.label: Value Field

fields.description: Optional child table field marking which rows this provider owns, for example provider or barcode_type.
fields.label: Ownership Field

fields.description: Value written to the ownership field on issued rows, for example keycloak or ID Card.
fields.label: Ownership Value
